scope: Owner requested the rest of the track editor review issues after chat items 1-4. Addresses JSON review priorities 4-8: serialization, repeated compiler preparation, drawing/navigation, cancellation/frame budgeting and cache/thumbnail cold work.

changes.serialization: A bounded immutable encoding cache retains compact JSON, authoring validation and fingerprints. WIP/original share the encoding; temporary verification and previous-good backups remain. The supported 16384-point painted map now fits the existing 512 KiB file limit.
changes.ordered_gesture_writes: Pointer-driven autosaves queue immutable directory/owner/document snapshots in one ordered low-priority writer, coalescing only queued revisions of the same draft. Explicit save/navigation/profile/new-document/deletion/teardown drain required writes; receipts bind to the captured library/document and report actual failures. Non-gesture calls and custom test/storage subclasses retain synchronous error semantics.
changes.compiler: Editor dependency keys ignore only id/name/creator. Immutable binary snapshots retain exact compiled grids, native metadata, route/gates, deck, physical kerbs/banks and contact buckets, then independently restore mutable results with current metadata/hash. Native construction accepts already prepared grid arrays, avoiding the RLE-expand round trip. Sections/raster/presentation masks reuse their own dependencies. Canonical schema/compiler version/hash semantics remain unchanged.
changes.drawing: Route data is sampled only when needed and retained with joins, local controls and roadside paths until source changes. Repeated snapped object/road/start-line movement suppresses redundant changes. Four-prop spatial batches retain original ordering/connected-normal clusters and original exact attribute/pixel results; update-on-demand viewport behavior remains.
changes.cancellation_and_publication: Tree-owned cancellable CPU jobs outlive closing population panels, which no longer join live workers. Obsolete road/scenery candidates stop at stage/loop/yield checks; compiler preview tokens stop stale sampling/raster/paint/preparation. Joined prop normals/indexing and large numeric stream assembly move to workers; changed GPU chunks stage before any live group replacement. Required teardown and durable-write drains still wait safely.
changes.byte_caches: Adds explicit byte estimates and reuse-based retention to compiled/editor visual/prop/thumbnail caches, plus bounded canvas/spline/roadside and mask/section preparation. Existing 32 MiB road and 64 MiB prepared-world cache allowances are preserved. Visible cold thumbnails bake one at a time, same-key cards share the result, and hidden/offscreen cards avoid allocating a viewport.

cache_limits.note: Mesh/node/material/texture figures are conservative accounting estimates, not direct process RSS or driver-allocation measurements. Active scene/card resources are necessary working state; oversized retained entries are omitted/evicted.
